articleTitle: Breast Cancer Prediction Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Breast cancer (BC) is the most frightful disease. It is becoming more severe day by day among the women. Death cases are increasing drastically. Two out of eight women die due to BC. Two types of tumors are used in the dataset for the classification of BC. Tumors are named as benign (noncancerous) and malignant (cancerous). Medical researchers use different types of scans like mammography and CT to find out the occurrence of BC. But by using Machine learning (ML) models we can predict the disease before its occurrence. Early prediction of BC could decrease the rate of death. The survival rate of the patients is also increasing. Women who live in polluted areas have a higher risk of BC because the presence of lead and mercury is very high in the environment, Pollution may cause cancer. In this paper three ML methods are utilized to forecast BC, such as Logistic Regression (LR), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN). These algorithms are supervised learning algorithms of ML. Total dataset of 569 rows and 32 columns and parameters such as id, diagnosis, symmetry_worst fractal_dimension_worst, etc. LR model performed better with 99% accuracy.

articleTitle: Controlling the SRM Drive in Electric Vehicles (EVs) and Microgrid using Fuzzy Logic Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: The EU's transportation emission reduction targets emphasize fuel-efficient automobiles, green fuels and power systems, and electric vehicles. Electric automobiles are reliable, safe, fuel-efficient, and green. HEV, PHEV, and EV electric drive systems depend on vehicle limits (motor size and weight, kind of vehicle, weight, payload, etc.), energy source (batteries, fuel cells, ultracapacitors), and driver demands. Due to expectations and possibilities, the electric power train must work like cars. A good and effective corporate VSD has always been hard to find in terms of operation and appearance. Only DC and induction motors were used. Comparatively SRM is simple, durable, and inexpensive, making it ideal for VSD applications. Building an electric drive system requires motor movement knowledge. Understand how power electronic converters create force and speed in electric motors. This thesis investigates SRM control in driving and generating modes with distinct goals. Controlling the SRM position demands consistent output force. Maintain DC bus voltage and maximize its use to generate electricity. This means a perfect machine model is needed for consistency. Only the stator of SRM has motor windings. SRM rotors lack wires and magnets, making them distinctive. The machine side is limited by technical ease. Unlike typical machines, SRMs need automatic communication switches to run on DC buses or AC lines. Machine resistive torque requires double stator-rotor saliency. This boosts non-linear magnetic properties. This makes SRM harder to assess and administer. SRM in the industry has several problems. Lack of electrical technology for SRM and too much industry-accessible AC and DC equipment were the main challenges. Firms save money and improve efficiency using SRMs. SRMs are hard to manage and need a shaft position monitor to track the rotor. This makes them noisier and have more power ripple than other motors. This is easy to disregard with SRM knowledge.

articleTitle: The Application of Internal Control Defect Identification under Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: In order to meet the challenges of application research in internal control defect identification, in view of the shortcomings of the existing fuzzy recognition algorithms, this study introduces an innovative application research method in defect identification based on data mining technology. This new approach uses the principles of data set theory to accurately identify and locate key influencing factors, and accordingly makes a sensible classification of indicators to reduce potential interference. At the same time, using the unique mechanism of data mining technology, this scheme cleverly constructs the design strategy of identification. The empirical results show that the proposed scheme shows a significant improvement compared with the traditional fuzzy recognition algorithm in terms of the accuracy of the application research and the processing efficiency of key factors in defect recognition, showing its obvious strong advantages. In internal control, the applied research in defect identification plays a crucial role, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth trend and output results of the applied research in the identification of internal control defects. However, in the face of complex simulation tasks, traditional fuzzy recognition algorithms show some inherent shortcomings, especially when dealing with multi-level challenges, their performance is often unsatisfactory. To overcome this, this study introduces a new idea of application research in defect identification of data mining technology optimization, accurately controls the influencing parameters through the data set theory, and uses this as the road map for index allocation, and then uses data mining technology innovation to construct a system scheme. The test results clearly point out that in the context of the evaluation criteria, the new scheme has been significantly optimized in terms of accuracy and processing speed for a variety of challenges, showing stronger performance superiority. Therefore, in the application research of internal control defect identification, the simulation scheme based on data mining technology successfully overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional fuzzy recognition algorithm, and significantly improves the accuracy and operation efficiency of the simulation.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Optimization of Channel and Power Allocation in 5G Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Optimizing resource allocation is becoming more crucial to fulfill the varied demands of 5G networks, such as minimal delay, connectivity to a vast number of devices, and fast data transmission speeds. Within the realm of 5G systems, a primary obstacle is the effective allocation of channels and power across a network environment that is characterized by its dynamism and diversity. In order to optimize power allocation and channel use in 5G networks, this paper presents a machine learning-based architecture. The primary aim of this study is to attain the most efficient network performance while reducing both interference and power consumption. The proposed approach integrates supervised learning and reinforcement learning algorithms to dynamically adapt resource allocation in real-time to the network's present condition and user demands. By using historical network data to predict the most efficient allocation methods, the model can adapt to different network loads and conditions at any given moment. By contrast to traditional heuristic methods, the simulation results show that the machine learning-based strategy greatly improves spectral efficiency, reduces power consumption, and increases the overall network throughput. Our study presents a scalable and adaptable approach to address the intricate resource allocation challenges in next-generation 5G networks. Our technology paves the path for 5G connections that are beyond the current capabilities in terms of sophistication and efficiency.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Leukemia Diagnosis: Fine-Tuned VGG19 CNN for Enhanced Classification Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: The complicated haematological cancer leukemia calls for precise and quick diagnosis techniques to increase patient outcomes. The VGG19 Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture is explored in this work for leukemia classification from high-resolution blood pictures. With a dataset of 7,500 photos split into four categories—"Benign," "Malignant Pre-B," "Malignant-B," and "Malignant early Pre-B"—the study seeks to improve automated leukemia detection by use of modern image processing and deep learning methods. Renowned for strong feature extraction, the VGG19 model is optimized with bespoke classification layers targeted for leukemia diagnosis. Early stopping and learning rate scheduling help to maximize performance by means of the Adam optimizer and categorical cross-entropy loss function in the training process. With accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and confusion matrix among other evaluation measures, the tuned VGG19 model shows an overall accuracy of 99%. With modest classification mistakes in "Benign" and "Malignant early Pre-B" instances, the model exhibits extraordinary performance in separating between leukemia subtypes. This work validates that the VGG19-based CNN method greatly improves automated leukemia classification, so offering a trustworthy instrument for raising diagnosis accuracy and helping medical practitioners in leukemia treatment.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication of Two-wheeler EV Charger by Using SMPS Technology for Industrial Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: In this research a Two-Wheeler EV battery charger fabrication part is proposed. Power transfer from grid to battery is achieved by crossing through two steps of conversion first one is AC/DC stage and then DC/DC stage, then output of the charger is linked to Two-Wheeler EV Li-ion battery. Two-Wheeler users in there parking condition they only need to plug in that charger into the socket and the charging will start. This charger can be used anywhere in their office premises or at home. In this paper, we have taken the On-board charger. The AC/DC conversion is taken place by using a rectification and filtration (filter is done by using a capacitor) process. Then using a DC-DC isolated converter is used for getting our required/desired DC value i.e., 58.4 V. Then this O/P voltage is sent to the rechargeable battery (Liion) of Two-Wheeler for charging. There is also an additional circuit connected known as the feedback path, which compares the output voltage of the charger with the desired voltage and gives the feedback about it.

articleTitle: Cloud Data Integrity Verification Algorithm for Accounting Informatization in Shared Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: In the sharing mode, the research on the cloud data integrity verification algorithm of accounting informatization is mainly to encrypt the data to ensure its security in the transmission process, so as to ensure the safety and reliability of accounting data in accounting informatization. In order to solve this problem, based on PKI technology, a cloud data integrity verification algorithm was proposed. The algorithm encrypts cloud data, and then uses symmetric keys to verify data integrity. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has high computing efficiency and strong anti-attack ability.

articleTitle: Forecasting of Wind Speed Using Deep Learning Method: A Case Study in Andhrapradesh
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Wind power forecasting is crucial for effective grid planning and load scheduling, leading to efficient grid management, reduced power loss, and lower production costs. However, as the analysis of large datasets becomes more complex, achieving accurate wind power forecasts becomes increasingly challenging. Therefore, implementing effective forecasting methods is essential. This paper introduces a novel wind speed estimating model using the Long short-term memory (LSTM) technique. To evaluate the model's effectiveness, it was compared with four other methods: Linear regression (LR), Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Decision tree (DT). The model was trained and tested using wind speed and meteorological data from the Narasaraopet, Andhra Pradesh region. Results show that all methods have, Mean Square Error (MSE), Mean absolute error (MAE), R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, Mean Absolute Percentage error (MAPE), and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) values between 0.017 and 12.1870, 0.102 and 2.596, 0.048 and 0.878, 1.149 and 60.098, 0.131 and 3.491 respectively. Support Vector Regression consistently performed the poorest across the board in terms of all metrics. The current work ends by emphasizing that, while all machine learning methods investigated in this research can be used to predict daily wind speed prediction data with little error, the RF and the LSTM algorithms produced the best results with the least amount of error. Then, that is followed in orderly succession by decision trees and linear regression.

articleTitle: Ultra-Low-Power Multiplexer Structures Targeting Efficient QCA-Circuit Designs
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: QCA technology is becoming a strong alternative for circuit implementation, offering advantages like improved energy efficiency, higher integration density, and faster switching speeds. In this work, we introduce two energy-efficient designs for 2×1 multiplexers (MUX) within the QCA framework, which are then used to build basic gates, a 4:1 MUX, and a full adder. These new MUX designs significantly reduce power consumption compared to existing designs while maintaining or improving performance in terms of area and latency. These MUX structures provide energy-efficient alternatives to traditional majority-based designs in QCA, paving the way for creating more complex and efficient circuits.

articleTitle: Intelligent Algorithm Optimization and Effect Evaluation of Smart Sms in Power Marketing
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of social economy, the competition in the power market has become more and more fierce, and at the same time, the field of power marketing is gradually moving into intelligence, so as to improve the service quality and user experience. As a very efficient and accurate customer communication tool, it can achieve a number of optimizations by using intelligent algorithm optimization, such as precision marketing and personalized service, and improving customer satisfaction. This study will explore the optimization and evaluation effect of intelligent SMS in power marketing, and carry out in-depth research based on its application in power marketing, combined with intelligent algorithm optimization and effect evaluation.

articleTitle: An Efficient Ensemble Deep Learning Model-based Signal Detection in 6G Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: In sixth-generation (6G) wireless communication, non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA), programmable meta-surfaces, and intelligent reflecting surfaces are pivotal technologies for augmenting spectrum efficacy, minimizing latency, facilitating extensive connectivity, and attaining elevated data rates. On the other hand, in wireless communication, signal detection is a fundamental aspect of communication systems, ensuring reliable transmission and reception of data. However, in 6G wireless communication, signal detection is more challenging due to the dynamic wireless environment, high mobility, increased number of devices, etc. To overcome the above limitations, this paper proposes an efficient ensemble deep learning model for signal detection in NOMA for 6G wireless communication. The proposed long short-term memory (LSTM)+1D-convolutional neural network (CNN) model combines the strengths of both LSTM and 1D-CNN models. The effectiveness of the proposed model has been compared with the conventional LSTM model, least squares, minimum mean squared error, and maximum likelihood models. Simulation findings indicated that the proposed model yields a superior symbol error rate compared to existing models and enhanced performance across differences in pilot symbols, cyclic prefixes, batch size, and learning rate.

articleTitle: Refining Ultrasound Imaging Quality Using SSIM & Advanced Artifact Removal Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Ultrasound imaging also known as sonography; is a medical diagnostic technique that uses high frequency sound waves in human body and creates an image. But sonography is also faces problem such as noise, Artifacts and resolution limitation. Here we propose a new method to enhance sonographical imaging by effectively designing both the structural similarity index (SSIM) and peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR). Measurement: PSNR (SSIM for artifact removal) In experiments with clinical ultrasound datasets, we observe an improvement of image quality. We have achieved up to 25% improvement in SSIM scores, as well improvements of artifacts by over 40%, and finally PSNR values boosted at some points higher than the better reference solution. The framework we introduce facilitates in promoting our diagnostic capabilities and ultimately patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Predicting Heart Failure Early with SVM Technology for Heart Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: This research employs the support vector machine (SVM) method for predictive modeling, adept at handling complex health data efficiently. Despite our stressful lives today, it is unlikely that heart health was significantly better in the past. Heart failure occurs when the heart's pumping function deteriorates. SVM identifies individuals at risk of severe vascular issues with an impressive 79% accuracy across various clinical indicators and risk factors. This high level of precision suggests that effective use of such predictions could revolutionize healthcare, allowing doctors to detect heart issues early and reduce healthcare costs. This study highlights the critical role of advanced computational methods in improving early heart failure detection and overall health monitoring strategies.

articleTitle: A Smart Hand Glove for Effective Communication of Deaf and Dumb People in Local Language
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Effective communication for people with speech impairments remains a significant challenge in our society. This project addresses the need for improved accessibility and inclusivity by developing innovative solutions for individuals with speech impairments. Specifically, the focus is on creating a solution that facilitates effective communication between the speech-impaired community and the public, grounded in the belief that everyone deserves the opportunity to express themselves and engage meaningfully in all aspects of society.This initiative aims to bridge the communication gap between the deaf and mute community and the public through an innovative IoT-based smart glove. The glove is equipped with gesture recognition sensors, a microcontroller, and a speaker to translate sign language gestures into spoken language, facilitating real-time communication. Flex sensors accurately capture hand movements and gestures commonly used in sign language, transmitting data to a microcontroller that processes the gestures using predefined code. This IoT-based smart glove serves as a portable and accessible communication aid, fostering inclusivity and enabling seamless interaction between the deaf and mute community and individuals unfamiliar with sign language. In this implementation, we are using Telugu as the local language for the glove’s output, further enhancing its relevance and usability for the regional population.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Enhanced Prediction of User Behavior on e-Commerce Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: User behavior plays a very important role in ecommerce platforms, but there is a problem that consumer purchase behavior prediction is not ideal. Previous sales methods could not solve the problem of predicting consumer buying behavior in e-commerce platforms, and the analysis was unreasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes a machine learning enhancement algorithm for predictive analysis of consumer purchase behavior. Firstly, the simulation theory is used to process the purchase behavior data information, and the indicators are carried out according to the requirements of consumer purchase behavior processing Segmentation, reducing distractions in user behavior. Then, the simulation theory predicts and processes the purchase behavior data, forms a predictive processing scheme, and predicts the results of user behavior Conduct a comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under the condition that the prediction processing standard is fixed, the machine learning enhancement algorithm has the accuracy of the prediction processing of purchase behavior data User behavior judgment time is better than previous sales methods.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Decision Technology Based on the Whole Process of Relay Protection Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: In order to further enhance the relay protection operation process of the comprehensive ability of safety intelligent decision-making, the study based on multiple scenario model fusion algorithm, using the minimum square difference estimation technology, establish the relay protection operation process of safety intelligent decision-making characteristics of massive data distribution model, and fully build the relay protection operation process of safety intelligent decision-making and emergency response system. Therefore, by refining the safe intelligent decision-making behavior of the whole process of relay protection operation and the abnormal characteristics of the operation path, and detecting the error component, it can enhance the dynamic intelligent decision-making and the credibility of the safe intelligent decision-making behavior of the whole process of relay protection operation.

articleTitle: The Control Strategy of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: In view of the limitations of the traditional Hash search algorithm in research on the control strategy of the permanent magnet synchronous motor, a research scheme of research on the control strategies based on Neural network was proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors is accurately located through nerve fiber theories, and the indicators is reasonably divided to reduce interference, and the Neural network is used to construct a research scheme for research on the control strategies. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional Hash search algorithm in terms of research accuracy and processing time of influencing factors of research on the control strategies, and has obvious advantages. The research of research on the control strategies plays an extremely important role in permanent magnet synchronous motor, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth characteristics and product generation of permanent magnet synchronous motor. However, the traditional Hash search algorithm has some limitations in solving the problem of electric machine control simulation, especially when dealing with complex problems. In this paper, this paper proposes a research scheme of research on the control strategies based on Neural network to better solve this problem. The scheme accurately locates the influencing factors through nerve fiber theories, so as to determine the division of indicators, and uses the Neural network to construct the scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the simulation scheme based on Neural network in research on the control strategy of the permanent magnet synchronous motor can better solve the limitations of traditional Hash search algorithm and improve the simulation accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Modified U-Net based Framework for Laparoscopic Procesures
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: This paper casts a spotlight on how AI can team up with laparoscopic surgery to boost the in-the-moment precision and overall outcomes of these procedures. This exploration is grounded in a wide-ranging survey of the literature that taps into several crucial topics: the U-Net architecture’s role in image segmentation, the essential "critical view of safety" in performing gallbladder removals, and how deep neural networks are changing the game when it comes to understanding and interpreting images. The research took advantage of a large dataset of cholecystectomy images, the CholecSeg8K, divided into bite-sized, high-resolution patches for intensive training and testing of the CNN models. The paper introduces a tuned-up modified U-Net based framework that also includes ensemble of other stellar models like VGG16 and ResNet 34 to take high accuracy. The evaluation of results has stamped the efficacy of the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Enhanced Brain Tumor Classification Using Optimized Convolutional Neural Networks: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: In brain tumors, both benign and malignant tumors significantly compromise health and call for accurate diagnosis and classification for the best therapy. This work uses Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Deep Learning’s ability to improve the accuracy of brain tumor categorization. Variations in CNN design are investigated to maximize model performance on a dataset including 7,523 MRI pictures categorized as glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, and non-tumor categories. The CNN model significantly improved accuracy by varying the learning rate and changing dropout and flattening layers; it reached up to 99% while lowering loss to as low as 0.0039. This work emphasizes the possibilities of DL in medical imaging, especially for automated brain tumor categorization, therefore providing a strong instrument for early and accurate diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Web-Based Attendance Monitoring System Utilizing QR (Quick Response) Code Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Attendance monitoring systems are vital for various industries, including corporate and education settings, in today's inevitable digital world. Father Urios Academy of Magallanes, Incorporated (FUAMI) suffered from discrepancies and inefficiencies in the manual attendance for the teachers. This research study, a Web-based QR (Quick Response) Code Monitoring System, aims to automate and refine the attendance tracking process of teachers in FUAMI and measure its functionality, efficiency, and user satisfaction. The System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) waterfall model has several stages, from planning, designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining. In the design and development phases, coding system requirements such as Visual Studio Code(VSCode), HTML5, Bootstrap 5, JavaScript, and jQuery for the frontend and PHP alongside Laravel Framework for the backend have been vital in the fulfillment of the entire project. The system elevates the FUAMI attendance monitoring into an organized, efficient, and reliable data storage and retrieval system. The system achieved a high level of acceptance among end-users, with a mean rating of 4.82.

articleTitle: Mmc Type Power Electronic Transformer Operation Reliability Composite Control Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: In the rapid development of power equipment today, the use of scientific and technological means to make transformers better development has made a trend, in order to more adapt to today's development, create high-efficiency transformers, so that transformer reliability improvement, MMC type power electronic transformers followed. In the operation of MMC type power electronic transformers, the transformer realizes the efficient conversion and transportation of electric energy by periodically storing and outputting electrical energy. The basic control strategy cannot accurately analyze the control problems in the operation of MMC power electronic transformers. Therefore, a composite control method is proposed for reliability analysis. Firstly, the composite control method is used to operate the MMC type power electronic transformer, and the indicators are divided according to the reliability requirements to reduce the interference factors in the reliability. Then, the composite control method is used to run the MMC power electronic transformer to form a reliability scheme and comprehensively analyze the reliability results. The research chart shows that the reliability of the composite control method for the operation of MMC power electronic transformers is better than that of the basic control strategy under certain control standards.

articleTitle: CoinRec: Object Detection Model for Indian Coin Recognition using YOLO
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: This Traditionally Indian coin recognition and segregation is performed manually. But it is very much time consuming and tedious process. Some researchers used machine vision algorithm to classify different coins. But currently few explanatory analysis of the trained models existed for the above classification. This work mainly focuses on building a machine vision model for the detection and identification of Indian coin denominations using modern deep learning algorithm YOLO. Also Eigen class activation map is used for better visual explanation of the model for the detection of Indian coins. The class activation maps provide a better visual explanation of how the model predicts the denomination of the coin from its image. The performance of resultant models after training and validation is almost more than 93% for the precision and recall. Similarly mAP50 and mAP50-95 of the resultant model is more than 98%.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach Integrating Deep Learning and Knowledge Graph for Detection and Recognition of Machine Parts
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: While machine learning powers impressive computer vision systems, they lack the human advantage of general world knowledge. This means they struggle to interpret visual data with humans' same richness of understanding. Accurate machine part detection is critical for intelligent manufacturing and automation. This paper employs a drilling machine as an example to demonstrate the approach to machine part identification. The model uses a specialized computer vision technique called Named Part Recognition (NPR) to recognize image components even with minimal training data. The model shows impressive accuracy in identifying parts of a drilling machine. Detecting machine parts is pivotal for identifying faulty components and averting malfunctions. It consistently detects the correct parts with a success rate between 89.6% and 92.5% (precision). Additionally, it rarely mistakes other objects for parts (high specificity exceeding 95%). This balanced performance is further highlighted by the overall accuracy consistently hovering around 95.5%.

articleTitle: Transforming Sign Language Interpretation with VGG16 and ResNet50 Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Sign language recognition (SLR) is crucial for effective communication with individuals who are deaf or hard of hearing. This study explores the application of two prominent deep learning models, VGG16 and ResNet50, in SLR tasks. By leveraging the VGG16 and ResNet50 frameworks, we achieved impressive accuracy rates of 99.92% and 99.95%, respectively, in detecting and interpreting sign language gestures. The exceptional performance of these models in accurately analyzing hand movements and gestures highlights their potential in enhancing communication for sign language users. Our research employs cutting-edge deep learning methods to advance SLR systems, paving the way for improved inclusivity and accessibility in communication.

articleTitle: Image Recognition Technology Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: This paper discusses the frontier exploration and application prospect of image recognition technology based on deep learning. Firstly, the application and importance of deep learning in the field of image recognition are introduced, and then the selection and construction of deep learning models are deeply studied, and a competitive image recognition model is constructed through a variety of research methods and experimental verification. This paper also focuses on the challenges existing in image recognition tasks, such as image recognition and image data processing in complex scenes, and proposes future research directions. Overall, this paper provides a useful reference for research and practice in related fields, and demonstrates the cutting-edge achievements and potential applications of deep learning in the field of image recognition. The image recognition technology based on deep learning has achieved remarkable results in the research, successfully realized the efficient recognition of complex images, and demonstrated amazing performance on a variety of datasets. By optimizing the structure and parameters of the model, the convergence speed and recognition accuracy of the model were improved. At the same time, the challenges and limitations of the model in practical application are also concerned, such as generalization ability, robustness, and computational complexity. In the future, we will continue to explore new algorithms and technologies to improve the performance and stability of deep learning models in image recognition tasks.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining Algorithms in Financial Analysis Software
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Risk management plays an important role in the application of financial analysis software, but there is the problem of inaccurate management positioning. Traditional iterative algorithms cannot solve the risk management problems in the application of financial analysis software, and the effect is not satisfactory. Therefore, this paper proposes the application of financial analysis software based on data mining algorithm and analyzes the application in financial analysis software. Firstly, the statistical set theory is used to locate the influencing factors, and the indicators is divided according to the requirements of risk management to reduce the interference factors in risk management. Then, the statistical set theory is used to form a risk management scheme of data mining algorithm, and the risk management results is comprehensively analyzed. The MATLAB simulation results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the data mining algorithm is better than the traditional iterative algorithm in terms of risk management accuracy and risk management influencing factor time.

articleTitle: Prediction Algorithm of Fracture Opening of Bedrock Lurk Reservoir Based on New Ensemble Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: In today’s rapid development of high technology, the use of scientific and technological means to make the better development of bedrock submerged reservoir reservoir has made a trend, in order to more adapt to the current development, create intelligent bedrock submerged mountain reservoir reservoir, so that the precision level of bedrock submerged mountain reservoir reservoir is improved, and bedrock submerged mountain reservoir reservoir reservoir is followed. In the bedrock reservoir, it is very important to collect, analyze and process the information of the life forms in the bedrock reservoir, so as to achieve the accurate realization of the bedrock reservoir. The digital iterative algorithm cannot accurately collect and analyze the information problems in the bedrock hidden mountain reservoir. Therefore, a new ensemble learning algorithm is proposed to predict and analyze crack opening. Firstly, computer technology is used to collect Internet information, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of crack opening prediction to reduce the interference factors in crack opening prediction. Then, the computer technology predicts the fracture opening of the bedrock lurk reservoir to form a fracture opening prediction scheme, and comprehensively analyzes the fracture opening prediction results. ANSYS simulation shows that the new ensemble learning algorithm is better than the digital iterative algorithm in predicting fracture opening and reliability of the fracture opening prediction of bedrock lurk reservoir reservoirs under certain evaluation criteria.

articleTitle: Design of All Digital Phase Locked Loop for Binary Frequency Shift Keying Modulation
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: In the rapidly advancing field of digital communication, the All Digital Phase Locked Loop (ADPLL) serves as a vital component for achieving precise clock synchronization. An ADPLL (All-Digital Phase-Locked Loop) is widely used in digital communication systems for clock generation, synchronization, and modulation, providing precise frequency control essential for high-speed data transmission and signal integrity. This paper presents the design and implementation of an ADPLL, where all four essential blocks—Phase Frequency Detector (PFD), Proportional-Integral (PI) Controller, 5-Stage Ring Oscillator, and Divide-by-N Counter in the feedback loop are implemented digitally. The ADPLL is designed with a center frequency of 100 MHz and demonstrates a lock range from 94 MHz to 106 MHz, showcasing its capability to maintain phase and frequency synchronization across a specified range. The described ADPLL finds its application in digital communication systems, particularly in Binary Frequency Shift Keying (BFSK) modulation. The entire design is realized using Verilog, and comprehensive testbenches were developed to simulate and verify the functionality of the system. The Vivado Xilinx tool was employed for simulation, enabling detailed analysis of the waveform outputs and confirming the ADPLL's effectiveness in digital communication scenarios.

articleTitle: Development of an Oblong Patch Antenna for single V-Band(47 GHz) with Enhanced Efficiency through Slot Modifications
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: This research article exhibits a novel design for compact microstrip antenna tailored for applications in the V-band. Featuring a return loss of -32.05 dB, the 47 GHz rectangular antenna exhibits excellent signal transmission and reception. The design incorporates interconnected rectangular and circular patches, resembling mathematical symbols, on a substrate of Rogers RT/Duroid 5880, having a thickness of 0.254 mm. It operates within a frequency range of 46.3-47.7 GHz. The antenna was designed using HFSS software, resulting in an impedance of 52.29 ohms. The design offers robust directional signal transmission and reception, maintaining excellent performance even over long distances. It exhibits excellent diversity performance, making it suitable for 5G devices, mobile networks, and wireless technology. The paper evaluates parameters such as E-plane and H-plane, Total gain, VSWR, and reflection coefficients.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Artificial Intelligence Optimization Algorithm in Power Grid Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Smart grid planning relies heavily on research and application, but the issue of imprecise planning and positioning persists. The conventional bee colony algorithm fails to address the research and application challenges in smart grid planning adequately, resulting in unsatisfactory outcomes. Hence, this study proposes the adoption of an artificial intelligence optimization algorithm for power grid planning research and application, while also analyzing its effectiveness. Initially, the simulated annealing theory is employed to identify influential factors and categorize indicators based on planning research and application requirements, thereby minimizing interference factors. Subsequently, the simulated annealing theory is utilized to formulate a comprehensive planning research and application scheme using the artificial intelligence optimization algorithm, followed by an extensive analysis of the planning research and application results. MATLAB simulation results demonstrate that, under specific evaluation criteria, the artificial intelligence optimization algorithm surpasses the traditional bee colony algorithm in terms of accuracy and time required for planning research and application influencing factors.

articleTitle: Ingenious K Nearest Neighbor based Systematic prediction of Early Floods in Uncertain Weather Forecasts
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to create and evaluate a clever K Nearest Neighbor-based systematic prediction system against the Decision Tree Classifier method for early flood detection in the face of erratic weather forecasts. The dataset was gathered from kaggle, a well-known website for group collaboration, datasets, and contests related to data science and machine learning. Employed with a sample mean size of 20 sets, and a decision tree classifier has been utilized to increase the accuracy of the current research. A total of 40 sets are being compared using K-Nearest Neighbor. The ClinCalc software appliance has been utilized to compute the average accuracy of the current study. The implementation was done in Python Programming Language and by using the SPSS Software, the statistical analysis is displayed. Following the completion of this study, the decision tree classifier and K-Nearest Neighbor both reached 98% and 95% accuracy, respectively. After performing an independent samples T-Test analysis, p=0.000 (p<0.05) was discovered to be the significance value, indicating statistical significance. The research adds to the machine learning algorithm emphasizing that the current study combines the decision tree classifier with the K-Nearest Neighbor algorithm. Following the completion of the research, this highlights the potential of the k nearest neighbor as a useful tool in this sector.

articleTitle: Outbreak of Glacier in Antarctica: Iceberg Movement Analysis using SAR Images
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Glacier displacement is cause of crisis environmental change. Glacier razes due to high impact of tsunami wave in Tohuku have triggered to continue giant hit on Sulzberger ice shelf of Antarctica. Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites used for regular tracking system to monitor the disaster effects. SAR is atmospheric convenience system could work in all weather conditions. The bounce of electromagnetic signals collects multiplicative noise named as speckle and is in need to reduce. Multitemporal images are implemented to find iceberg displacements using un-decimated discrete wavelet transform. Difference images are segmented by two-level clustering method to differentiate class distribution. This experiment provided prominent accuracy of 97.77% with exact boundaries.

articleTitle: Real-Time Image Detection With Braille Output
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: This project focuses on developing an innovative assistive device designed to enhance navigation for deaf-blind individuals across various environments. The device utilizes an integrated camera module, such as those found in laptops or phones, for real-time object recognition. A compact Braille display, driven by solenoids, provides immediate tactile feedback upon recognizing common objects like bottles, persons, and cell phones through advanced image processing algorithms. A dedicated mobile application facilitates object recognition, text extraction, and translation into tactile Braille output using custom code. This tactile feedback empowers users with enhanced spatial awareness and navigation capabilities, promoting greater independence and safety in everyday surroundings. By integrating cutting-edge technology with inclusive design principles, the project aims to meet the unique accessibility needs of the deaf-blind community effectively.
