This transition is largely driven by Government of India and utilities' interest in leveraging new technologies to enhance revenue realization and for improved accuracy and efficiency with improved data.AMI systems are integral to the modernization of electrical grids, facilitating improved energy management and real-time communication between utilities and consumers. These systems rely on a variety of communication technologies, primarily Cellular, Radio Frequency (RF), and Power Line Communication (PLC). The effectiveness and efficiency of AMI systems are closely relied on the adoption of appropriate communication technologies as per field requirements.This paper evaluates the performance of various communication technologies used in AMI systems, drawing data from laboratory-based testing. We analyze key technologies, including RF and Cellular, focusing on their performance under different Service Level Agreement (SLA) test cases. The findings provide valuable insights for the possible selection of suitable communication technologies for implementation of AMI systems.

articleTitle: Classify Text Using K-Nearest Neighbor Algorithm to Reduce the Term Vector Space
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: An essential part of text mining is text categorization, which involves the automatic sorting of many documents. The area of text categorization has benefited greatly from the introduction of several supervised learning algorithms. One of the greatest text classifiers because to its simplicity and effectiveness is the K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) algorithm, which is one of these helpful strategies. One common approach to text classification is the vector space model, which involves representing a single document as a vector with a sequence of chosen words called feature items. A vector space model-based algorithm is KNN. Nonetheless, according to the conventional KNN algorithm, every feature item's weight in different categories is the same. I don't think this makes any sense. Because these features may have varying degrees of relevance and distribution across several categories. We propose a new and improved KNN method that takes variance into account, in light of this drawback of the original KNN algorithm. The results of the experiments demonstrate that the refined upgraded KNN outperforms the conventional KNN classifier.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on the Real-Time Text Categorization of User Generated Content using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: With the rapid increase in social media usage, there has been a corresponding surge in user-generated content (UGC) being generated on a daily basis. This has created a demand for efficient and effective real-time text classification of UGC to monitor and extract valuable insights for businesses and organizations. Our goal in doing this systematic review was to compile all of the most up-to-date information on the best practices for user-generated content (UGC) text categorization in real-time on social media. Various sources, such as academic databases, digital libraries, and online periodicals, are combed through to find relevant material for the review. The focus is primarily on recent research conducted between 2015 and 2023, with an emphasis on identifying emerging trends, challenges, and opportunities in the field. The review critically examines the different approaches employed for text classification, encompassing machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing techniques. Furthermore, it explores the specific social media platforms where text classification is carried out, such as Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram. The review highlights the key challenges associated with real-time text classification of UGC, such as handling large data volumes, dealing with language ambiguity, and the need for continuous training and updates. Additionally, the study underscores the potential opportunities for future research in this domain, such as the development of hybrid models that combine multiple approaches to enhance accuracy and scalability. The insights gained from this systematic review will be valuable for researchers, practitioners, and businesses engaged in real-time text classification of UGC on social media platforms.

articleTitle: A Radio Frequency Fingerprint-Based Zero Trust Authentication System for IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: The ultimate goal of next-gen networks is seamless communication across all types of devices, systems, people, and machines. Given the chance for network-wide effect of a single hack, this interconnectedness raises issues about privacy and security. Regardless of the precise data transmitted, radio frequencies fingerprint (RF fingerprint) analysis is a crucial technique used to physically identify the distinct radio transmitter. The RF fingerprint represents the variations in radio transmitter internal components and includes extensive nonlinear properties. The extraction and identification of radio frequency fingerprints has been widely used to improve the safety of radio frequency communications in both civilian and military settings. In response to this threat, the Zero Trust (ZT) model has emerged as an important tool for protecting data privacy and network security. With an emphasis on resource-constrained IoT devices, this study offers EPS-CNN, a new framework for wireless device identification that utilizes deep learning. It is intended to function as the device authentication layer inside the ZT architecture. The heart of EPS-CNN is a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) that uses a specific representation of RF signals called the Double-Sided Envelope Power Spectrum (EPS) to build a device identity. This EPS captures the hardware characteristics of the device and ignores information that isn't related to it. When evaluated in same-domain (day, setting, and channel) settings, the suggested structure achieves testing accuracy of over 99%. When tested in crossday and cross-location scenarios, it achieves 93% accuracy. By providing a groundbreaking approach to enable ZT IoT device identification, our research proves that the suggested framework is the best way to improve the precision, resilience, and flexibility of deep learning-based methodologies.

articleTitle: Latent Dirichlet Allocation for Topic Discovery and Segmentation in Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Using Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) for topic identification and segmentation in big data helps identify significant patterns and topics from large text corpora. LDA will be implemented and optimized to rapidly process and analyze large datasets, revealing hidden subjects and enhancing content structure. Creating a strong framework for accurate and scalable subject modeling would improve analysis and decision-making in social media analytics, consumer feedback, and academic research. The LDA technique must be refined to accommodate large data's great dimensionality and complexity while being computationally efficient. An innovative topic identification tool that processes large-scale text data quickly and reliably will reveal theme patterns and improve big data management and use. The Bigdata Corpus results demonstrate the results for Topic Distribution Across Documents in a sample of 5 topics and 5 documents vary from 0.1 to 0.25. The same dataset also has Top Words per Topic. 10 example words for 10 subjects the identical dataset with another instance has values from 0.03-0.15. Document clustering based on topic proportions in a sample of 5 documents clustering 5 topics yields 0.1–0.75.

articleTitle: AI Assisted Real Time Response Systems for National Emergency Preparedness and Disaster Management
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: This paper focuses on a real-time response system supported by AI developed to improve national emergency readiness and disaster response. The proposed system includes decision support for disaster response through real-time data processing with the application of machine learning/deep learning algorithms applied to the data collected from IoT sensors, satellite images and social media commenting. Hence, the proposed system optimizes the resources, the probability of the forecasts and decisions made through the integration of linear programming, probabilistic models, and stochastic optimization. Having positively noted the effect of the system on response time of aggregated queries, the Level 2 priority simulations also revealed that the offered optimization of resource allocation is comprised at 90%, while the deep learning statistical information of disaster prediction conveys an important accuracy of 89%. The Resource management policies ensured effective manner of delivering personal and operational necessities, which flexibly changed depending on the situation. This research also shows the ability of the system to improve Disaster management by increasing efficiency in managing large-scale emergencies.

articleTitle: An RCNN and Gaussian Mixture Approach to MRI Tumor Classification and Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Brain tumour identification and analysis is an essential component of any indication system, as proven by numerous studies and the steady advancement of relevant methodologies. Since this study relies on accurate tumour detection, a reliable automated method is required. For more accurate brain tumour classification, several segmentation algorithms have been created. Brain image segmentation is notoriously tough, according to specialists in medical image processing. The authors of this paper offer a new approach to automated detection and classification. The proposed approach is divided into multiple steps, such as MRI image preprocessing, image segmentation, feature extraction, and feature classification. As part of the preprocessing phase, an adaptive filter is used to decrease the noise in the MRI image. For feature extraction, we use the grey level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM), and for picture segmentation, we use the improved Means clustering (IMC) method. Following feature extraction from MRI scans, we used a deep learning system to classify scans as either benign lesions, gliomas, meningiomas, or pituitary tumours. The classification job was completed with the help of recurrent convolutional neural networks (RCNN). The suggested method outperforms the state-of-the-art in terms of classification for every given input dataset that contains brain images. In this study, MRI images from 464 testing sets and 3264 training sets were used from Kaggle's data sets. According to the results, the new approach is much better than the old ones. Three of the most widely used classification algorithms at the moment—BP, VG-Net, and RCNN—are compared to the proposed RCNN method. In MRI scans of brain tumours, the proposed classifier correctly identified 97.81 percent of the tissues.

articleTitle: A Dual Stage Malicious User Detection Method By Using Adaptive Threshold Testing and Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: With the advent of big data and cloud computing, the security of users' private data has become a pressing issue. Despite the availability of several detection and prevention solutions, ransomware has developed with the intention of extorting victims for money in exchange for their data. Experts have investigated methods of detecting ransomware based on both files and behaviours. Unfortunately, ransomware remains a concern because of the challenges associated in to identify and avoid it. One important limitation of existing methods is that they cannot detect ransomware in backup systems, such as cloud services. It is pointless, for instance, to synchronise malicious files with system backups since ransomware cannot be decoded from backed-up data. In this work, we build a Dual Stage Malicious User Detection (DSMU) method to provide the highest level of security in the vast data cloud. First, the data is separated into two groups, "Normal" and "Suspicious," using Adaptive Entropy barrier testing. The next step is to identify whether or not the suspicious data are authentic by applying a classifier built around a Support Vector Machine (SVM). The recommended method allows users to restore encrypted files from a backup system even if malware has infected their primary workstation. The files infected that were copied to the backup systems may be removed this way. The proposed method has been shown in analytical comparisons to standard detection methods to have a higher detection rate and a lower false positive and false negative rate.

articleTitle: A Blockchain-Based Model Migration Method for Safe and Long-Term Federated Learning in Internet of Things Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: A growing number of IoT devices are turning to federated learning (FL) to provide secure data exchange without compromising user privacy. In addition, new research suggests that blockchain technology might bolster FL security. When data in a BFL cluster is scarce, however, current blockchain-based FL (BFL) systems struggle. Gathering a large number of devices to form a BFL cluster is a straightforward answer. However, because to their geographically dispersed locations and the enormous distances between them, these devices have very high levels of connection delay. Due to the frequent contacts in the blockchain consensus, BFL's poor system efficiency would be caused by the high latency. It is possible for attackers to manipulate local models in FL. Therefore, it is possible for manipulated local models to produce an inaccurate global model. So, to provide safe model aggregation, the suggested system uses a blockchain network. By using a blockchain consensus method, nodes in the network may check that the combined model is legitimate, then add it to the distributed database where it will be safe from tampering. Before utilizing the aggregated model, each cluster may get it from the blockchain along with ensure its integrity. In order to assess how well the suggested framework worked, we ran many experiments using various CNN models and datasets.

articleTitle: A Method for Identifying Parkinson’s Disease from Spiral Images (Graphs) Created by Hand
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: A chronic brain ailment known as Parkinson’s disease (PD) affects millions of people around the globe. The breakdown or death of brain cells responsible for producing dopamine, a neurotransmitter that regulates movement, causes this condition. Issues with mobility, equilibrium, and posture are brought on by PD, which develops as a result of this. To lessen the disease’s course and boost patients’ quality of life, early diagnosis is essential. A cosine annealing scheduler and deep transfer learning are presented in this study as a method for handwriting-based prediction. It uses handwriting samples from people with and without Parkinson’s disease, found in the NIATS collection. With the use of spiral sketching and CNN, this research hopes to provide a PD detection method. The main concept is to determine whether a person is healthy or has Parkinson’s disease based on their spiral drawings. Spiral drawings made by individuals in good health resemble conventional spiral forms. People with Parkinson’s disease have sluggish movement and poor hand-brain coordination, therefore their spiral drawings seem deformed because they stray greatly from the correct curve. This research presents the results of using a Convolutional Neural Network to diagnose Parkinson’s disease; the classification accuracy achieved was 83.6%.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Workflow-Based Performance Appraisal System for Electric Power Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: With the deepening of the reform of the electric power system and the development of the electric power industry, the production and operation management of enterprises has put forward higher requirements for performance appraisal management. Through the establishment of the performance appraisal system, on the one hand, it can standardize the daily performance appraisal workflow of power enterprises and improve the efficiency of performance appraisal, and on the other hand, it can provide a basis for performance decision-making by senior leaders of enterprises and realize scientific decision-making of performance management. Based on the characteristics of production and operation of electric power enterprises, this paper designs a workflow-based performance appraisal system for electric power enterprises based on in-depth analysis of system functional requirements and technical requirements. The system uses key technologies such as workflow engine and workflow view to realize the automation of business processes, and improves the efficiency of enterprise performance appraisal through the design of functional modules such as system data collection, calculation and statistical analysis. After practical application verification, the system has good scalability and maintainability.

articleTitle: Bayesian Energy Consumption Prediction Method and Application of Campus Buildings Based on Monitoring Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: In view of the limitations of the traditional gray wolf algorithm in the Bayesian energy consumption prediction method and application of campus buildings, a Bayesian energy consumption prediction method and application scheme based on monitoring data algorithm were proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors is accurately located through the data set theory, and the indicators is reasonably divided to reduce interference, and the Bayesian energy consumption prediction method and application scheme is constructed by using the monitoring data algorithm. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional gray wolf algorithm in terms of Bayesian energy consumption prediction method, application accuracy, and processing time of influencing factors, and has obvious advantages. Bayesian energy consumption prediction methods and applications play an extremely important role in campus buildings, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth characteristics and product generation of campus buildings. However, the traditional gray wolf algorithm has certain limitations in solving the simulation problems of prediction methods, especially when dealing with complex problems. In this paper, a Bayesian energy consumption prediction method and application scheme based on monitoring data algorithm is proposed to better solve this problem. The scheme accurately locates the influencing factors through the data set theory, so as to determine the division of indicators, and uses the monitoring data algorithm to construct the scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the simulation scheme based on monitoring data algorithm can better solve the limitations of the traditional gray wolf algorithm and improve the simulation accuracy and efficiency by using the Bayesian energy consumption prediction method and application of campus buildings.

articleTitle: Optimizing Fertilizer Recommendations for Crops Using Gradient Boosted Decision Trees with Logistic Regression and GA
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: The research being conducted focusses on the essential issue of enhancing fertilizer recommendations for crops through the utilization of soil and environmental data. The proposed method combines Gradient Boosted Decision Trees with Logistic Regression, augmented by a Genetic Algorithm for hyperparameter optimization, to deliver accurate and efficient suggestions. In contrast to current methodologies, which frequently exhibit constrained accuracy and adaptability, our model shows substantial enhancement, attaining an accuracy of 95.4%, an F1 score of 94.8%, and a recall of 96.2%. The exceptional performance metrics demonstrate the model's efficacy in precisely forecasting appropriate fertilizer quantities and varieties under diverse situations. The study demonstrates the capacity of this innovative method to enhance precision agriculture by offering data-driven, real-time decision assistance for farmers, resulting in improved crop yields and resource management relative to conventional ways.

articleTitle: IoT based Drowsiness Detection with Automated Vehicle Control
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: A major danger to road safety, drowsy driving is a prominent cause of accidents globally. Drowsy driving is thought to be the cause of 100,000 crashes in India each year, accounting for 1,550 fatalities and 40,000 injuries. We suggest a comprehensive system that blends sound, seat vibration, and a brake mechanism to identify and prevent cases of drowsy driving in order to solve this problem. To determine the driver's level of wakefulness, the system uses sophisticated monitoring techniques, such as analysis of the driver's eye movements and head posture. Early indicators of drowsiness are recognized by the system, which then activates numerous alerts, including an alarm, seat vibration, and braking, to quickly warn the driver and prevent accidents. We carried out experiments using carefully chosen datasets from Kaggle, which cover a range of driving conditions, to assess the efficacy of the proposed method. We also cite a study by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, which found that using a similar sleepy driving detection technology significantly reduced the number of drivers falling asleep at the wheel by 45%.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Building Energy Efficiency Based on Chaotic Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: In view of the limitations of traditional image recognition algorithms in the comprehensive evaluation of building energy efficiency, a comprehensive evaluation scheme of energy conservation based on chaotic neural network was proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors is accurately located through the complex neuron theory, and the indicators is reasonably divided to reduce interference, and the chaotic neural network is used to construct a comprehensive evaluation scheme for energy saving. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional image recognition algorithm in terms of the accuracy of comprehensive evaluation of energy saving and the processing time of influencing factors, and has obvious advantages. The comprehensive evaluation of energy conservation plays an extremely important role in construction projects, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth characteristics and product generation of construction projects. However, traditional image recognition algorithms have certain limitations in solving building evaluation simulation problems, especially when dealing with complex problems. In this paper, a comprehensive evaluation scheme of energy conservation based on chaotic neural network is proposed to better solve this problem. In this scheme, the influencing factors is accurately located through the complex neuron theory, so as to determine the division of indicators, and the chaotic neural network is used to construct the scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the simulation scheme based on chaotic neural network can better solve the limitations of traditional image recognition algorithms and improve the simulation accuracy and efficiency in the comprehensive evaluation of building energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Enhancing Energy Efficiency and Security in IoTDriven Smart Cities Using Hybrid GAN-ICA Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: The rapid emergence of IoT-powered smart cities has generated substantial apprehensions regarding energy efficiency and security. Current technologies frequently fail to adequately address these concerns in a comprehensive manner. This study presents a hybrid framework that combines GAN with ICA to improve energy efficiency and security in smart city infrastructures. The design of the model utilizes GANs to generate synthetic data and ICA to extract independent characteristics, resulting in improved accuracy and security of IoT systems. The accuracy of our model surpassed that of previous technologies, reaching 97.5%. Additionally, our model achieved a precision of 95.0% and an F1 score of 95.6%. As a result, our model has established a new benchmark in smart city research. The results showcase the model's capacity to enhance smart city operations, rendering it a worthwhile addition to the field.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Models for Smart Pothole Detection: Enhancing Road Safety and Maintenance Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a Smart Pothole Detection System designed to enhance road safety and improve maintenance efficiency through machine learning and geospatial analysis. Using smartphone applications, road images with corresponding XYZ coordinates are collected and labeled as either "pothole" or "no pothole". This dataset is utilized to train and evaluate multiple machine learning models, including Support Vector Machine (SVM), Logistic Regression, and Logistic Regression integrated with the AdaBoost ensemble method. These models are compared based on their accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, to determine the most effective solution for pothole detection. SVM emerged as the best-performing model, demonstrating high-dimensional data handling capabilities, while the AdaBoost-enhanced Logistic Regression model also performed competitively. Our system holds promise in contributing to real-time, automated pothole detection, which is essential for proactive road safety management and efficient maintenance planning.

articleTitle: Implementing Cloud Computing with Internet of Things (IoT) technologies: Novel approaches to data management and service delivery innovation
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: The integration of cloud computing and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies has created new opportunities in the fields of data management and service delivery. This study examines the creative strategies for combining cloud computing with IoT, with a specific emphasis on inventive techniques for managing data and improving service delivery mechanisms. First, we analyse the fundamental principles of cloud computing and IoT, emphasising the harmonious relationship between these two fields. Now, we will explore the difficulties that arise with incorporating cloud services into IoT setups, including concerns around data security, scalability, and the need for real-time processing. Our research focuses on doing a thorough review of the most advanced strategies used for managing data in cloud-IoT systems. We examine the function of edge computing and fog computing as intermediary tiers that connect IoT devices with cloud data centres. In addition, we explore the utilisation of sophisticated data analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence in cloud-IoT ecosystems. These technologies provide intelligent data processing and the provision of predictive services. Additionally, our study examines the novel service delivery models that arise from the convergence of cloud computing and the Internet of Things (IoT). We examine the influence of cloud services on Internet of Things (IoT) applications, encompassing smart cities, healthcare, transportation, and industrial automation. The article showcases case studies that exemplify the pragmatic application of cloud computing in Internet of Things (IoT) situations, elucidating the advantages and difficulties experienced in actual installations. Ultimately, the paper highlights the significant capacity for synergy between cloud computing and IoT technologies. This text explores innovative methods that are influencing the future of data management and service delivery, leading to more effective, adaptable, and intelligent Internet of Things (IoT) applications. This research adds to the continuing discussion on the incorporation of new technologies and provides a guide for professionals and scholars in the sector.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Sentiment Analysis Based Teaching And Learning Process Via Audio Feedback Using MFCC & PSO
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Accurately gauging student mood in the rapidly evolving digital education landscape is particularly challenging, given the limitations of conventional evaluation techniques in virtual learning environments. Meaningful improvements in curriculum, instructional materials, pedagogical approaches, and assessments necessitate the proper evaluation of student feedback. This research integrates a Naïve Bayes classifier with Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to enhance the accuracy of sentiment analysis in student feedback. The proposed method addresses the challenges of feature extraction, feature selection, and noisy data, such as background noise, variations in speech, and inconsistencies in audio quality—all crucial for effective sentiment analysis categorization. Student feedback is collected in audio format, with features extracted using Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC). By optimizing feature selection, the PSO method improves the Naïve Bayes classifier's accuracy. The sentiment analysis report categorizes feedback as positive, negative, or neutral, giving faculty members concrete information to improve their teaching tactics. This strategy fosters a customized and encouraging learning environment that is beneficial to each student's progress by guaranteeing a deeper comprehension of the emotions and thoughts of students.

articleTitle: Transforming E-Learning: The Impact of CampusIQ
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: The problem of fitting in the individual learning needs in traditional e-learning environments and LMS has frequently generated learner disinterest and raised attrition rates. Many of these traditional solutions are usually uniform, ignoring the fact that students have different strengths and weaknesses. Despite the extensive functionality of such online education systems, they do not significantly impact a student’s progress. To address these challenges, we propose CampusIQ, an AI-driven gamified application built using Flutter. This system is made to serve the purpose for its users throughout their education by embedding adaptive learning via analytics and recommendations engine. CampusIQ relies on artificial intelligence which performs a detailed analysis of student data right from the time they board, by using class averages, and individual performance metrics among others. For each student, it creates a personalized plan for every learner that can recognize all areas in need of improvement or that are strong points for him/her leading to excellence. Moreover, the incorporation of game mechanics promotes engagement and motivation levels hence transforming a dull monotonous process into an interesting personalized experience. This paper presents the architecture, methodology, and results of CampusIQ, demonstrating its effectiveness in addressing traditional educational shortcomings and offers an example of how to deal with the conventional educational defects and promote adaptive education by enhancing engagement and increasing learning productivity and memory rates in students. Our comprehensive evaluation shows that there are noteworthy improvements in academic performance, memorization rates, and stress management, indicating that CampusIQ could potentially disrupt traditional education methods.

articleTitle: Feature Selection based Sentiment analysis using Combination of Nature Inspired Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Social media now-a-days in the best source of collecting information about any product, movie and many more. The persons using the social media prefer to share their reviews or comments in different platforms like X, Facebook, online shopping sites, which helps others to get information about the product. Even company people, who developed the product also helpful by these reviews to know the shortcomings of their product and able to prepare a new product after eliminating the issues. These reviews can be collected from the sources and can be processed to generate information. These reviews need to go through the different process until the final conclusion is obtained. When the dataset containing the reviews are large in size, processing time is increased and thus, feature selection technique is preferred, which will select a representation of the features. Thus, in this work, a combination of two nature inspired algorithms are considered i.e., Cat Swarm Optimization (CSO) and Artificial Neural Network (ANN). The CWO acts as the feature selection algorithm and the selected features are given input to ANN for classification. Finally, the result is calculated with the help of confusion matrix and other performance evaluation parameters associated with it.

articleTitle: Combining CNN and SVM for High-Precision Wheat Disease Classification using Leaf Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: This study presents a novel classification algorithm designed to accurately identify plant diseases using leaf image analysis. The model employs a hybrid architecture containing a CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) and an SVM (Support Vector Machine) classifier, featuring 2 convolutional layers and 2 max-pooling layers. A variety of datasets encompassing five distinct plant diseases have been utilized for assessment: Stripe Rust, Powdery Mildew, Leaf Rust, Septoria Leaf Blotch, and Fusarium Head Blight. For each disease category, the model can correctly classify a positive case with precision values ranging from 92.45% to 93.75%. Similarly, the recall values are consistent with a range from 91.84% to 94.12%, which were very good too and would be shown that no matter what was taken into account either ring or original brain scans researchers could obtain positive instances well enough using this model resources The model showcases a significant performance, with F1-Score (a balanced metric concerning precision and recall) having high values constant between 92.78% and 93.75%. Support Proportions indicate how much of the overall dataset can be attributed to a given disease class and Support Values show where there are occurrences in each proportion. Its great Weighted Average Accuracy of 93.25% shows that the model is trained on a wide range of plant diseases so it does not only work for one or two datasets but across all datasets. This endto-end macro-average and micro-average evaluation, again only shows all around effectiveness of the model. Results & conclusions: This study provides a highly accurate automated plant disease diagnostic model, which is of great significance for crop management and precision agriculture. If validated through follow-up studies, the findings could improve crop yields and sustainability as well as help develop remote sensing technology that rapidly identifies plant disease.

articleTitle: Enabled Model for Face Detection and Reply According to the Expression
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: The proposed AI model demonstrates promising results in accurately detecting facial expressions and providing contextually relevant responses. Once an emotion is detected, the model selects an appropriate response from a predefined set of responses tailored to each emotion. The responses are generated using natural language processing (NLP) techniques, The new AI model uses deep learning techniques, specifically convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to accurately classify emotions such as happiness, sadness, anger, anger and disgust, and neutrality. The model uses NLP techniques, NLP-based techniques, such as recurrent neural networks and NLP to generate responses tailored for each emotion, to create more contextually responsive responses to each instance of NLP.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Machine Learning Medical Image Registration using Recurrent Deformed Pyramids Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: For many therapeutic uses, including image-guided therapies, picture registration is crucial in medicine. Though challenging, this field of medical picture registration has lately seen significant algorithmic performance improvements because to the rise of machine learning. Some medical applications are made possible by deep neural networks, such as faster and more accurate picture registration, which is crucial in the fight against malignancies during surgery. Medical image registration procedures sometimes include complex distortion issues. Despite the several suggested sophisticated registration models, deformable registration continues to be a tough task, particularly when dealing with large volumetric deformations, in terms of accuracy and efficiency. Our unsupervised pyramid attention networks (PAN) and network are designed for non-rigid and flexible registration, respectively, with this goal in mind. In contrast to networks that depend on high-weight attentions or transformers, our network is a clean convolutional pyramid, making full use of the pyramid structure's inherent benefits. Specifically, our network guarantees the deformation field's rationality by predicting it from coarse to fine using a step-by-step recursion method that incorporates high-level semantics. Our network is able to achieve deformable registration without the need for separate affine pre-alignment because of the recursive pyramid technique. In terms of Dice scores, average symmetric surface separation, Hausdorff distance, and Jacobian, our network constantly outperforms state-of-the-art, according to experimental data. Our network continues to perform well in adjusting for the huge deformation even when the affine pre-alignment is not included in the data.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Enabled Security and Integrity Mechanisms for Wireless Sensor Networks in IoT Systems*
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) and the Internet of Things (IoT) together present before unheard-of possibilities and difficulties in maintaining data integrity and authentication inside these systems. The application of blockchain technology as a distributed and strong answer to solve these problems is investigated in this work. By means of a thorough investigation of current developments, this article assesses blockchain-based architectures meant to improve security, lower latency, and guarantee data integrity in WSN-IoT systems. We suggest a thorough assessment of several blockchain technologies and their implementation in practical situations stressing its possibilities in industrial IoT, smart cities, healthcare, and smart homes. Though problems including scalability and energy consumption still exist, our results imply that blockchain integration greatly enhances data security and system efficiency.

articleTitle: Optimizing Brain Tumor Classification through Innovative Texture-Based MRI Analysis: A Fusion of Novel GLCM and LBP with SVM Ensemble for Enhanced Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: The exact categorization of brain tumors poses substantial difficulties in medical imaging due to complex tumor variations and diagnostic delays. This study presents a new method to improve texture-based information obtained from MRI scans for diagnosing brain malignancies, including gliomas, meningiomas, and pituitary tumors. Our approach involves combining distinctive features derived from the Gray-Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) with conventional Local Binary Pattern (LBP) histograms. This combination significantly enhances classification accuracy. Additionally, we generate new features through comprehensive feature engineering techniques, including creating aggregated features, interaction features, polynomial features, normalized features, and subtractive features. To address class imbalance, we employ the Random Over-sampling strategy, duplicating data points in the minority class to ensure equal representation. This strategy achieves a notable classification accuracy of 92.81%, surpassing the most cutting-edge existing methods and showcasing its potential to enhance the investigation of brain tumors in clinical environments.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach for ECG-Based Cardiac Anomaly Detection with Improved Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Heart disease is a global health concern that requires accurate and timely prediction tools for successful management and treatment. Electrocardiogram (ECG) data analysis helps discover cardiac anomalies by revealing heart function and risk factors. ECG data is complicated and variable, making interpretation and prediction difficult. Researchers have used preprocessing, feature extraction, and machine learning algorithms to enhance heart disease prediction. Ensemble learning can improve predictive performance by combining model predictions. This study attempts to improve cardiac risk assessment and patient outcomes by merging multiple techniques.The goal of this paper is to improve heart disease prediction accuracy by evaluating ECG data using machine learning techniques. To improve cardiac abnormality identification, preprocess ECG images, extract key characteristics, and use ensemble learning. The work investigates signal contour extraction and dimensionality reduction to provide a comprehensive cardiac risk assessment algorithm.The study uses a multi-step technique to improve heart disease prediction using ECG data. Preprocessing ECG pictures with signal contour extraction, grayscale conversion, and Gaussian blurring improves data quality and clarity. To find predictive modelling features, feature extraction methods like PCA dimensionality reduction are used. Ensemble learning methods like the Voting Classifier combine predictions from numerous machine learning models to increase predictive performance. Hyperparameter adjustment improves model performance, achieving 98% testing set correctness. This study's methods give a complete foundation for precise and fast cardiac risk assessment.

articleTitle: Text Mining for the Identification and Synopsization of Trusted Ratings
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Online reviews have become increasingly valuable in the realm of purchasing and business decision-making. They not only contribute to brand loyalty but also aid customers in understanding product experiences. Unfortunately, the rise of fraudulent reviews, where authors are rewarded for generating fake evaluations to manipulate readers' perceptions, is a growing concern. This research paper aims to address this issue by developing a product review summarizer specifically designed to generate summaries based on genuine Amazon product reviews. The summarizer utilizes text analysis techniques to assess the linguistic characteristics of sentences and determine their value. The paper provides a comprehensive overview of existing and previous studies on sentiment analysis and text description. To enhance classification accuracy, a new hybrid classification system is proposed, combining multiple classification methods using arcing classifiers. The quality of these classifiers is thoroughly evaluated. In this study, supervised machine learning algorithms are compared with SVD dimensionality reduction, deep learning, and a text mining approach for summarization purposes. The model is built using a labeled Amazon review dataset. The key contribution of this paper lies in its innovative approach of generating text summaries for Amazon reviews while effectively filtering out fraudulent content.

articleTitle: Instruction Decoding for Dual-Core Soft-Processors using Reed-Solomon codes
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: An area- and power-efficient unified fault-tolerant instruction decoder architecture for dual-core RISC-V RV32IM processors is proposed in this paper, targeting the improvement in reliability for Single Event Upset-susceptible environments. The proposed design uses a DMR system supported by Reed-Solomon error correction codes to enable real-time detection and correction of single-bit and multiple-bit errors. It underscores, in particular, the Reed-Solomon technique, which, for its strong capability of dealing with burst errors, gives a large advantage over parity-based error detection. Under computation by this decoder are the syndrome for the arriving instructions and then the use of the Berlekamp-Massey and Forney algorithms to compute locations and magnitude of the errors, which easily enable the exact correction of corrupted instructions. While TMR increases complexity and power consumption, DMR combined with Reed-Solomon provides similar fault tolerance levels with much reduced resource overhead. The architecture has been designed in Verilog HDL to ensure efficient resource utilization while maintaining superior fault coverage. Consequently, the results of the simulations ensure that the decoder is able to detect and correct the injected errors in the two instruction streams and guarantee fault tolerance operation with a power consumption of 28% less compared to classical majority voting-based TMR approaches. Therefore, this proposed architecture is highly suitable for aerospace and other embedded systems applications in which both power efficiency and fault tolerance are highly desired.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis Of Machine Learning And Deep Learning Models For Text Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Information retrieval and data fields that concentrate on automated lengthy text categorization are becoming more popular due to the quick development of modern science and technology. However, machine learning-based text categorization learning must be thoroughly examined and assessed from an algorithmic, model, assessment, and other perspective. This article classifies texts using the deep learning approach. First, the traditional text classification procedure is explained, which includes pre-processing data, segmenting the text, creating features, summarizing the classification algorithm, and so on. Second, text categorization is done using CNN with multiple convolution kernels. The word vector model takes the role of the conventional bag of words model, and text characteristics are extracted using a multi-dimensional convolution kernel. Deep learning models—primarily convolutional neural networks and multilayer perceptrons—have been more and more popular recently for use with these kinds of datasets. Since there isn't any such integrated study, the purpose of this research is to evaluate how well deep learning models perform on various cancer gene expression datasets. Three deep learning models, two feature selection techniques, and four cancer gene expression datasets have been taken into consideration for this aim. The experiment in this study showed that CNN models performed promisingly in text document classification, but it also raised the following questions that need more, in-depth investigation: 1) How to compare the performance of the suggested models more effectively. Which text-based categorization tasks are best suited for each model? 2) How to better comprehend the facts. Specifically, what was learned by the deep learning model? 3) Adjusting hyperparameters. The process of hyper-parameter tuning is one that requires expertise. 4) Label imbalance: how to modify the sample weight in a loss akin to the bootstrap approach when the data samples are labeled unevenly. 5) On a given data set, what is the simplest neural network structure that can get a certain level of accuracy?

articleTitle: Enhancing Data Integrity and Authentication in WSN-IoT Systems using Blockchain Technology*
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: With the combination of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) and Internet of Things (IoT), the field of data acquisition and communication has been transformed in most of the areas including smart city and industrial use. However, such systems are relatively insecure especially concerning the integrity of data, as well as identity authentication. This paper aims to investigate how blockchain technology cab strengthen WSN-IoT systems by offering distributed and secure mechanisms. Considering the pros and cons of applying existing approaches, we present a conceptual framework based on blockchain, which enhances data security and provides reliable ways of user identification. As the research suggests, there are enhanced aspects of security from the identified threats, and a decreased number of open entrance for invasions, coupled with higher veracity of data in various IoT applications. Different parameters are used in order to analyze the performance of the proposed framework in real-time environments.

articleTitle: Accurate Information Analysis Scheme for High Level Security Provisioning in Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Many experts agree that cloud computing represents a major technological advance for the Internet and related computer systems. This shift has led many companies to outsource both their information and computer needs. Such systems need to be secure in terms of integrity, availability, and confidentiality, the three cornerstones of information security. Cloud computing gives users access to virtualized, services that are scalable that are adaptable and need no upkeep. It's conceivable that the protocols and infrastructure supporting cloud computing are inadequate. The vulnerabilities are being exploited by attackers. There has been much discussion about how vulnerable cloud infrastructure is to distributed denial-of-service (DDOS) attacks. A denial-of-service (DDOS) attack is characterised by the simultaneous transmission of a large number of information packets. Because all of the network's and servers' resources have been exhausted, an denial of service has occurred. In an attempt to identify DDOS assaults early on, a number of methods have been proposed and analysed. It's possible that an attack detection system need only use a single machine learning classification method, however utilising many models is recommended. In this study, we suggest using several neural network classifiers together. The proposed technique uses a Hybrid Mechanism for intrusion detection, which combines the Teacher Learning Optimisation (TLO) using a Fully Recurrent Neural Network (FRNN). We looked at information from the CICDDOS2019 information set, which included a total of 32,000 incidents (8,450 benign and 23,550 DDOS attack occurrences). Experiment results showed a 98.02 percentage of accurateness, 97.5 percent sensitivity, and 98.5 percent specificity.

articleTitle: Enhancing Secure Data Transfer In Wireless Networks Using Onion Routing And Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: The proliferation of cyber-attacks, data breaches, and the disclosure of sensitive information has elevated the issue of secure data transfer via wireless networks to a crucial level of awareness. This research delves at the potential of combining Onion Routing with Blockchain technology to improve the security of wireless data transfer. By encrypting data in layers and routing it through several nodes, Onion Routing provides great anonymity and makes it difficult for attackers to trace the communication channel. By transparently and immutably recording all transactions, Blockchain technology guarantees data integrity and eliminates the possibility of tampering. When used together, these technologies provide an exceptionally safe method of data transmission via wireless networks; this is especially important in industries like healthcare, finance, and government that place a premium on confidentiality and confidentiality of information. We put the system through its paces to see how it handled latency, throughput, packet loss, and power consumption. While there are significant improvements to security, the results show that there are performance trade-offs including higher latency and energy consumption, which might make the system unsuitable for real-time or situations with limited resources.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Intrusion Detection Systems for Strengthening Critical Infrastructure Security
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: The innovation in the complex attacks continues to pose a risk to critical infrastructure systems, hence the need to exert enhanced security. Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), which are typically based on static positive signatures and rule-based technologies, is incapable of identifying new threats and tends to produce more false alarms and slow reaction times. Thus, this research introduces an ML-integrated IDS that incorporates the use of the state-of-art ML techniques, including neural networks, support vector machines, reinforcement learning, among others, to enhance ID accuracy, reduce false alarms, and minimize detection delay. In the evaluated study, simulated in the critical infrastructure environment and evaluated by IDS using NSL-KDD dataset the AI-IDS had significant performances: 95% detection accuracy, 4% false positive and average of 0.8 sec of detection latency. The system displayed better flexibility and effectiveness for threat detection and response actions while offering improved performance in real-time arrangements. These changes over the traditional approaches show great potential in propelling better protection of critical assets against new and advanced cyber threats.

articleTitle: Risk Prediction of Heroin Drug Consumption using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Heroin, an illegal and extremely addictive opioid derived from morphine, is commonly administered via injection, sniffing, snorting, or smoking. Users initially experience an intense "rush" of pleasure, followed by effects such as skin flushing, dry mouth, limb heaviness, severe itching, nausea, vomiting, and prolonged drowsiness. Severe health problems, including as mental health disorders, abscesses, and illnesses of the liver, kidneys, and lungs, are linked to chronic usage. Additionally, injecting heroin greatly heightens the risk of developing infectious illnesses like as HIV and hepatitis, and can lead to blocked veins. In this work, we applied multiple machine learning algorithms to accurately detect heroin consumptions. Among these models, CatBoost classifier demonstrated superior performance, achieving an accuracy of 88.66%. This highlights CatBoost’s efficacy in the accurate detection of heroin consumption, highlighting its potential to improve detection systems in both forensic and clinical contexts.

articleTitle: An Analytical Study of Assorted and Resilient Rice Blast Varieties Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: The following presents a novel technique that can be used for automated disease identification in plants by combining a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier. The suggested CNN-SVM model is trained and evaluated on a dataset that consists of images of healthy and diseased plant leaves. Classification performance assessment includes such metrics as certainty rate, recall, F1 score, instance count, instance ratio, and accuracy. The outcomes indicate its excellent classification ability across different diseases such as the Healthy class with an 88.17% recall rate and 95% accuracy. Additional categories including Leaf Blast, Neck Blast, Node Blast, and Panicle Blast show good competitive performance in terms of precision, recall, and F1-score. Overall, the proposed approach shows promise in the accurate and effective classification of plant diseases with potential benefits for crop management toward sustainable agriculture.

articleTitle: Enhancing Safety and Reducing Congestion in Smart Cities Using CrowdLOC-S with Graph Attention Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: The growing complexity of metropolitan areas demands intelligent solutions capable of successfully tackling issues associated with safety and congestion. This study offers a Graph Attention Network (GAT) combined with CrowdLOC-S data to improve safety and reduce congestion in smart cities. The proposed approach utilizes graph-based learning to effectively capture spatial and temporal connections in crowd-sourced data, surpassing standard models in critical measures including accuracy, F1 score, and recall. The model reached an accuracy of 98.6%, an F1 score of 0.985, and a recall of 0.987, demonstrating substantial enhancements compared to prior models with accuracies of 92.5% and 89.3%. The results illustrate the effectiveness of the GAT model in enhancing urban management systems, establishing this method as a feasible alternative for real-time traffic and public safety monitoring. This research enhances smart city management and facilitates future progress in intelligent urban systems.

articleTitle: Optimizing Routing Protocols for Energy Efficiency in Large-Scale WSN-IoT Deployments*
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: In this paper, energy optimal routing protocols used in large scale WSN with internet integration are discussed in detail. Given the fast growth of IoT, the efficient management of energy in WSN has implied improved lifecycles and sustainable use of WSN. Generally, IoT uses WSNs in which the network consists of large numbers of sensor nodes that need to be low power. Hence, when defining routing protocols that may help in control and even reduction of power usage from the network, then ensuring high data reliability in the network must be given uttermost priority. The contributions of this work are as follows: Provides a thorough review of different types of routing protocols Reviews the protocols’ energy efficiency levels and their evolving best practices Reveals areas where prior work may have limitations for usage with large-scale implementations. Some of our contributions to the field are as follows These areas are represented by a comprehensive assessment of the existing standard and the development of new approaches that integrate adaptive procedures, data accumulation methods, and effective communication structures to increase energy-use efficiency in WSN-IoT systems.

articleTitle: Combined-Jelly-Snake optimization with Deep Learning Architecture for Task offloading in Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Edge computing allows devices with limited processing power to transfer their computational tasks to nearby edge servers for efficient processing. However, effectively managing offloading decisions to meet latency requirements and optimizing resource allocation during peak loads while ensuring consistent service quality remains a significant challenge in edge computing. To tackle this issue, a CNN-based task offloading method is utilized. The approach incorporates essential components such as a wireless body area network (WBAN), edge servers (ES), and a medical center integrated into edge computing for the offloading structure. Various sensors are distributed across the patient’s body to form a patient-centered WBAN, which records medical monitoring data and transfers it to the appropriate gateway user node (GUN) responsible for task computation decisions. The GUN handles task-related data scaling, which serves as input for the CNN. The CNN produces a result ranging from zero to one, where "0" indicates local task execution and "1" indicates task offloading to an edge server (ES). An optimal resource allocation based on a hybrid algorithm is proposed to effectively manage workload demands while maintaining efficient performance.

articleTitle: A Decentralized, Effective Blockchain Oracle Scheme for IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: A large number of IoT applications have used blockchain technology in recent years. There has been a lot of buzz around blockchain oracles, which connect blockchain and off-chain data transmission. The effectiveness and safety of data collecting for oracles are greatly compromised by the vast and diverse array of devices that make up the Internet of Things (IoT). The effectiveness and reliability of the oracle system as a whole is impacted by the matching connection among data sources with oracle nodes. In order to tackle these problems, this article suggests an efficient and distributed oracle solution that is designed for the Internet of Things. It allows for the quick gathering of off-chain data in real-time. To address the heterogeneity of IoT devices, we first develop a distributed oracle design that integrates conventional and Trusted devices to enhance system scalability. Secondly, we allocate suitable nodes to jobs to improve system efficiency by determining the matching connection between nodes and their data sources, which is based on the information supplied by trusted devices about trustworthy nodes. As a second step toward making the data even more consistent, we suggest a sliding window data filtering technique. The suggested method is confirmed to be secure by doing a security analysis. The experimental findings validate the effectiveness of the suggested system in enhancing the oracle's service quality. Experiments in simulation have shown that our suggested alternative significantly improves the system's efficiency and service quality, cutting average response time by around 15% when compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: Insider Threat Detection on CERT Data Using Pre-trained ResNet
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: The detrimental cyber-attacks frequently originate from individuals or insiders within an organization who are considered reliable and trustworthy, as opposed to individuals with suspicious motives from outside the organization. This insider is difficult to detect, as it may not leave any evidence behind, yet possesses the potential to cause considerable harm to the organization. To tackle this issue, numerous researchers have diligently sought out various methods to effectively identify insider threats. These methods employed for the identification of insiders within an organization who pose a threat from within have been proven to yield elevated rates of false alarms, which in turn lead to a state of disarray and confusion within the organizational framework, consequently resulting in a dampening of morale among the members of the organization due to the disruption of their regular work. Therefore, a methodology was presented for categorizing insider threats that are motivated by the effectiveness of the classification of the images. The publicly available CERT r4.2 standard insider threat dataset was used and to avoid the class imbalance issue data augmentation was applied. The objective of this research is to detect insider threats and evaluate the ResNet50 model. Finally, the approach has achieved 97.54% accuracy and classified the insider threat efficiently.

articleTitle: Automatic Topic Classification And Document Clustering Using Lda Based Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Since more and more information is being stored in digital formats (such as databases, journals, libraries, and papers), it is crucial that this information be put to good use. However, it might be challenging to extract meaningful insights from the data because of its poor organisation, ambiguity, and lack of precision. Data may be correctly categorised to allow for separate research on different types of data, which will help with this problem. Because of this, researchers in disciplines like mathematics and computer science have been trying to figure out how to fix the issue. Material mining is a branch of machine learning that helps cope with unstructured and disorganised data by sifting through it for useful insights. Text mining is a subfield of data mining that focuses on discovering patterns and extracting structured attributes from unstructured text. To successfully analyse such data, supervised learning is combined with unsupervised learning. It has become common practise to employ Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), a probabilistic approach to topic modelling, when classifying documents. As an unsupervised method, however, traditional LDA's findings may shift depending on which articles come first in the analysis. In this study, we provide a comprehensive strategy for avoiding the order effect as well as the unsupervised probabilistic character of the problem. The proposed framework achieved a success rate of 95.56% & 95.23% when evaluated on two separate datasets, demonstrating its better classification capabilities. Furthermore, the subjects that were extracted from the classified clusters are highly relevant to the domain classifications.

articleTitle: A Dual-Stage Deep Learning Model for Cyber Data Classification and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Cyberbullying is on the rise, according to recent research, especially among adolescents. In this research, we provide an innovative approach to text-based automated categorization for the purpose of detecting cyberbullying. However, due to the problem of over fitting, a classifier cannot offer a locally converging solution. Given these constraints, we built a text categorization engine to do some preliminary work on the tweets, erasing noise and background details before extracting the required features and categorising without data overfitting. In this research, we create a new Dual Stage Deep Learning (DSDL) method by first using Deep Neural Networks for feature engineering and then employing Deep Q-Learning for classification. Results from validating the innovative Deep classifier show that it increases text categorization accuracy.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis: Aspect-based analysis for Market Insights and Customer Feedback Valuation
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: E-commerce platforms have been witnessing a rapid expansion leading to an overwhelming amount of customer reviews which can be a source to obtain valuable insights on performance of the product and customer satisfaction. This paper delves on a machine learning approach to perform sentimental analysis on customer reviews. With a major focus on aspect based sentimental analysis(ABSA) for customer feedback valuation on various headset brands. With flipkart reviews dataset, the experiment aims to develop a model that can classify the overall sentiment of the consumer into positive or negative and dives deeper into product aspects such as sound quality, battery life, and comfort. This involves data preprocessing, sentimental scoring, aspect extraction and model evaluation using BERT. This will help us have strong framework for identifying actionable insights, allowing businesses to enhance marketing strategies and improve customer service. In the future the project can be developed further to include multilingual datasets and refining the accuracy of the model, examining its application to various social media platform

articleTitle: CropOptimizer: Intelligent Crop Forecasting and Decision Support System
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: CropOptimizer is an innovative crop forecasting and decision support system designed to revolutionize agricultural practices. Comprising five key modules—crop recommendation, fertilizer suggestion, disease detection, weather forecasting, and market price tracking—CropOptimizer combines modern technologies to help farmers make informed decisions. The crop recommendation module, leveraging XGBoost, uses soil, climate, and nutrient data to select suitable crops that maximize production potential. The fertilizer suggestion module provides specialized guidance based on specific crop and soil characteristics, ensuring effective nutrient management through XGBoost. The disease detection module employs deep learning with ResNet-9 for image processing to identify plant diseases from leaf images, followed by specific treatment recommendations, achieving high accuracy. Weather forecasting offers a 7-day forecast, including rainfall predictions, based on plant type, state, and city through an API. Market price tracking provides live market prices for various crops, enabling farmers to make informed selling decisions. By integrating these components, CropOptimizer increases crop yield and sustainability, fostering a more resilient agricultural ecosystem and improving food security and economic success.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Techniques in Wireless Sensor Network for Sensor Nodes
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are an emerging field of technology with a wide range of applications, namely, smart cities and environmental monitoring. The network’s long-term sustainability and the uninterrupted functionality of sensor nodes suffer tremendously due to their energy constrained nature. In recent years, new developments on ways of using energy efficiently have played a great role in solving these problems by optimizing resources, increasing network lifespan and improving data transfer techniques. Notable improvements are the sophisticated techniques of scavenging for energy that draw upon solar, thermal, vibration and different environmental energy sources that were used to supply sensor nodes with energy. Machine learning techniques, most notably reinforcement learning and predictive analytics, have become common in the management of energy in a dynamic fashion as well as optimizing the network's duty cycle. To these, it is noteworthy the progress made in energy efficient routing protocols such as multi-path and energy balanced clustering which helps reduce energy loss during data transmission. Innovative sleep scheduling schemes and data aggregation methods also help to conserve energy by shortening the on time of sensor nodes and lessening the number of active data transmissions. In addition, new developments in hardware design such as ultra-micro low-power microcontrollers and small power transceivers have resulted in lower power consumption of sensor nodes. These combined efforts directed to energy efficiency are key in increasing the operating time of WSNs and improving their efficiency by facilitating better distribution in different areas of use and application.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security and Privacy in Blockchain-IoT Hybrid Healthcare Database Systems through Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: This study focusses on the crucial matter of security and privacy in healthcare database systems, specifically in the context of blockchain-IoT hybrid ecosystems. Conventional machine learning methods, although efficient, sometimes fail to adequately protect sensitive healthcare data, particularly in the context of decentralized systems. A new solution is suggested to address this issue by combining federated learning with blockchain-IoT technologies. This integration provides improved data security and privacy while maintaining high speed. The suggested methodology utilizes decentralized learning to guarantee that data remains localized, hence minimizing the possibility of breaches and unauthorized access. The suggested system outperforms existing approaches such as Random Forest and Support Vector Machine (SVM), reaching an accuracy of 97.8%, an F1 score of 95.85%, and a recall of 95.2%. The model's performance in safe and accurate data processing is demonstrated by its findings, which exceed the metrics of Random Forest (93.2% accuracy) and SVM (95.4% accuracy). The research not only enhances the sector by delivering a more resilient solution but also paves the way for practical applications in healthcare, presenting a substantial enhancement over current technology.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection and Prevention System for DDoS Attacks using Hybrid CNN Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Machine-based intrusion detection systems are crucial for network protection and data security in this age of widespread Internet connectivity and consistent growth in data quantities. However, current methods of both shallow and deep learning fall short when trying to capture the intricate incursion patterns associated with data transmission. To combat this, we offer a large data-based hierarchy deep learning system to further improve the effectiveness of IDS-based artificial intelligence. Both network traffic as well as content information may be captured by the proposed system thanks to its behavioral and content-functional features. Each framework deep learning model is dedicated to understanding the data structure of a specific cluster. For this reason, we advocated the use of a convolutional Neural Network (CNN) using a Min-Max optimization approach. When compared to earlier single-learning models, the suggested method increases the categorization rate of disruptive attacks. Incorporating a larger number of devices also speeds up the system's model-building process.

articleTitle: A Novel Recurrent Neural Net based Dimension Reduction Technique for Effectual Data Visualization
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: t-SNE, UMAP, & Tramp have shown excellent visualization performance on various real-world datasets. These approaches may preserve global structure but not local structure, a trade-off that has always plagued them. Computer science RNN machine learning is evolving. RNN models can reliably forecast numeric values or nominal classifications, but a general-purpose mechanism for RNN architecture construction has yet to be devised. Computer scientists must use trial-and-error to create accurate RNN models. Models often need multiple input parameters. When there are many input factors, it might be hard to determine which ones affect model prediction the most. Science calls this the "curse of dimensionality." Problems may be reduced to two dimensions, however. Humans can plan and understand two-dimensional problems. Visualizing a multi-dimensional dataset may reveal which input factors most affect a nominal or numeric outcome. Identifying these factors may help train RNN models faster by utilizing only input variables that impact the result variable. This study explores RNN training methods and uses dimensional reduction to see and interpret complicated data.

articleTitle: Enhancing Doodling Experience Using Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: Interacting with AI systems solely through textual prompts often encounters limitations due to the challenges of expressing complex visual ideas in text. This paper introduces an advanced AI system that interprets and visualizes users’ sketches by employing state-of-the-art Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), such as pix2pix, SketchGAN, DCGAN, and ESRGAN. This system not only significantly enhances real-time interactions but also shows exceptional proficiency in image editing tasks, thus facilitating more intuitive communication between humans and AI. By enabling rapid and accurate visualizations, this technology substantially streamlines and improves design workflows in the architecture and fashion industries. The advancements fostered by this system contribute significantly towards achieving greater capabilities akin to Artificial General Intelligence, enhancing creative processes and production efficiencies.

articleTitle: Using Millimeter-Wave Wireless Networks for Opportunistic Wiretapping and Jamming
publicationTitle: 2024 Global Conference on Communications and Information Technologies (GCCIT)
abstract: This study presents a novel model for opportunistic wiretapping with jamming (OWJ) attacks in millimeter-wave (mmWave) wireless networks, despite the fact that mmWave communication is resistant to traditional wiretapping attacks owing to its narrow transmission range and directivity.
